note: An f16 GEMV whose weight is K-contiguous, the [out, in] layout of an F.linear weight, on a coop band whose lanes each read 8 adjacent reduce elements, so a lane reads its slice of a weight row as one 16-byte load.

attrs.body:
for a0 in 0..2048:
    for a1 in 0..1024:
        in0 = load x0[0, a1]
        in1 = load x1[a0, a1]
        f32 v0 = multiply(in0, in1)
        acc0 <- add(acc0, v0) over a1
    linear[0, a0] = acc0
